title: Verified ledger cursors and projection verification

claims.text: read_events validates after, limit, wait_ms, agent_id and kinds, filters matches before limiting a page, returns resync when after exceeds the head, and polls on a monotonic deadline while releasing each snapshot before waiting.

verify_ledger captures the journal report, certifies canonical agent projections inside the IO boundary, raises busy when the journal changed during verification, and reports external and unrun scope entries as unverified.

_verification_data maps the integrated reports to the frozen wire shape with codes bad_args, hash_mismatch, projection_drift and torn_tail, and verify_main delegates to the ledger_verify tool through _delegate.

decision.rule: Change here when event cursor paging, polling, or agent projection verification needs to change.
decision.failure: A filtered reader strands on a nonmatching page, verification misses a projection drift, or a changed journal is certified anyway.

questions.q: Where does read_events page filtered matches without stranding the cursor?
Where should I change how verify_ledger certifies agent projections?
Where can I debug why ledger_verify reports a torn tail or projection drift?
